desc: Derive and document that the optimal target value for a window is a median, and define the window cost as the sum of absolute differences to that median.

Implement efficient sliding-window median/cost computation for all length-x windows using coordinate-compressed Fenwick trees (counts and sums), handling negative values and duplicates, and return the minimum operations cost for each window.
Design the DP state for choosing t non-overlapping windows within the first i array positions, with transitions for skipping position i or taking the window ending at i.
Implement the DP with optimized memory, ensuring it runs in O(nk) after window costs are computed.
Test edge cases such as k = 1, adjacent chosen windows, all equal elements, negative numbers, and windows covering the full array.
Validate the final implementation against the provided sample tests and constraints.
